content.title: Trusted Concrete Contractor in
content.description: Maxima Concrete proudly serves homeowners throughout Columbus with custom driveways, patios, sidewalks, retaining walls, and outdoor living solutions. Using premium materials and proven installation techniques, our in-house team delivers durable concrete projects built to withstand Ohio’s climate and enhance your property’s value.

steps.title: Demolition & Site Prep
steps.description: We remove the old surface, set the proper grading, and make sure water drains away from your home.

steps.title: Compacted Gravel Base
steps.description: We install and compact a gravel base that carries the load and keeps water from undermining the slab.

steps.title: Forms & Reinforcement
steps.description: We set the forms and place fiber mesh and 10-gauge wire mesh — then you approve the layout before anything is poured.

steps.title: Professional Concrete Pour
steps.description: We pour our 6.5-bag high-strength mix, protecting your yard and driveway throughout the process.

steps.title: Finish, Cure & Final Walkthrough
steps.description: We apply the finish you chose, monitor curing, and walk the finished project with you before we leave.

From the first walkthrough to the final inspection, the same process
